governance: THE CANONICAL RIGHTS RECORDS. One record per organisation, each carrying the Atlas Image Permission Outreach id it reflects. This file is the INPUT; image-rights-manifest.json is generated from it by .github/scripts/generate_image_rights_manifest.py and must not be hand-edited. Recording a grant or a withdrawal means editing a record here, regenerating, and committing both in the same act.
how_to_add_a_supplier: 1. Record the permission in Atlas (Image Permission Outreach) first; that is the source of record. 2. Add a record here carrying its record id and ref. 3. permission_outcome must be one of the gate's live-grant or known-non-grant values, spelled exactly. 4. permitted_domain is the supplier's own site. 5. If their site serves images from a third-party CDN, add permitted_delivery_hosts with the host AND a path prefix narrow enough to be theirs alone -- a host without a prefix is refused. 6. required_credit if the grant is conditional on one. 7. Regenerate. 8. Run the gate.

bothan_attribution.conflicting_evidence: Cormac Carville, Yard Box, by email 29 September 2026 (thread 1a0d05e09446b7fe, message 1a0ed8a508425026): "Credit design and Manufacture to Yardbox." bothan_attribution.imagery_effect: The attribution hold no longer excludes Bothán imagery. Any Bothán image must still pass the ordinary ownership, permission and delivery-host checks on its own merits — the lifted hold grants nothing.

bothan_attribution.footprint: Cormac's correction stands and is unaffected: the Bothán 45 m² figure is the INTERNAL footprint. INTUMODULAR's page publishes 45 sqm without stating a measurement basis, so it neither confirms nor contradicts this.
bothan_attribution.contact: Cormac is NOT to be contacted about this. Founder direction, 29 September 2026: resolved from first-party published evidence.

records.note:
ALL 25 GOVERNED DON IMAGES ARE CGI VISUALISATIONS. This is not a caveat added for safety; it is what the images are. Every exterior and every interior on donmodularhomes.ie is an architectural render. The distinction is carried in the governed Atlas asset records themselves rather than in a new schema field: each asset's alt text begins 'Visualisation:' and each asset's Notes carries the sentence 'computer-generated visualisation published by the supplier, not a photograph of a completed build'. The render path reads alt text from the governed record, so the distinction survives to the page without any frontend change. Nothing in the publication path rewrites or discards it, and nothing may be added that implies these are photographs of completed installations.

No delivery host is declared: Don serve their own images from donmodularhomes.ie/images/, so the first-party domain is the scope.

25 assets governed in Atlas on 2 October 2026 — the complete unique set across the whole site, after collapsing responsive variants (-828, -1080) and .jpg/.webp pairs, and probing for further files that do not exist. No candidate was excluded. One record additionally notes that the supplier's own alt text for interior-9 describes a bathroom while the image shows a bed alcove and kitchen; PlotNua's alt text follows what was actually seen.

NO PRODUCT RECORDS WERE CREATED. Don sell one configurable steel-frame design priced per square metre; the 1/2/3/4-bed pages are size variants of the same building, not distinct models. Imagery is governed at organisation level accordingly.
